semiconductor_relevance: High — Latent Technologies Inc. specializes in silicon carbide (SiC) technologies and provides a range of materials and equipment solutions for the semiconductor industry.
summary: Latent Technologies Inc. is a leading provider of silicon carbide (SiC) materials and equipment solutions, focusing on crystal growth, wafer processing, and advanced process integration. With over two decades of experience, the company serves a global customer base in semiconductors and high-power electronics, offering one-stop solutions that span the entire semiconductor value chain.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Headquartered in Taoyuan, Taiwan, with additional operations in Hsinchu.
regional_presence.China: Operates in Shanghai to serve the local semiconductor market.
